passages.title: The Hidden Life of Soil
passages.text: Beneath every field lies a world that the eye cannot see. A single teaspoon of healthy soil may contain more microorganisms than there are people on Earth. These tiny organisms break down dead leaves and animal waste, releasing nutrients that plants need to grow. Some bacteria, living in the roots of pulses such as gram and peas, convert nitrogen from the air into a form that plants can absorb. This is why farmers have traditionally rotated pulses with cereals. However, excessive use of chemical fertilisers and pesticides can kill these helpful organisms, leaving the soil tired and lifeless. Scientists therefore urge farmers to add compost and to avoid ploughing too deeply. Healthy soil, they argue, is not merely a medium to hold plants upright; it is a living partner in agriculture whose care determines the harvest of the coming decades.

passages.title: The Late Bell
passages.text:
MEERA: (looking at the clock) Arjun, this is the third time this week you have walked in after the bell.
ARJUN: (breathless, eyes lowered) I know, madam. I am sorry.
MEERA: Sorry does not mend a broken habit. Where were you?
ARJUN: At home, madam. My little sister has a fever. Mother has gone to the fields, so I waited until the neighbour came to sit with her.
MEERA: (her voice softening) Why did you not tell me this before?
ARJUN: I was afraid you would think I was making excuses. Everyone does when a boy is late.
MEERA: (after a pause) Then I owe you an apology. I judged you before I asked you. Go and take your seat. And Arjun, if you ever need help, my door is open.
ARJUN: (a faint smile) Thank you, madam.

passages.title: Libraries Deserve Better
passages.text: In many small towns, the public library is the only quiet corner where a child without a study table at home can open a book. Yet these libraries are often the first casualties when budgets are trimmed. Shelves hold outdated volumes, ceilings leak, and a single overworked clerk doubles as librarian and watchman. Officials argue that the internet has made libraries redundant. This argument is shortsighted. Not every household owns a smartphone, and not every smartphone user can tell reliable information from rumour. A good library offers both access and guidance. The cost of renewing a collection and keeping a reading room open until evening is modest when set beside the cost of a generation that cannot read critically. Local bodies should treat libraries not as ornaments of the past but as essential public services, funded as regularly as roads and street lights.

questions.question: In the sentence 'Seeing the police, the thieves ran away', the word 'Seeing' is -
questions.explanation: 'Seeing' is a non-finite verb form that modifies 'thieves', so it is a present participle. It is not finite (no tense or subject agreement), not a gerund (which works as a noun) and not an infinitive (which needs 'to').

questions.question: Ten kilometres ___ a long distance to walk.
questions.explanation: A distance treated as a single unit takes a singular verb, so 'is' is correct.

questions.question: She ___ in Raipur since 2015.
questions.explanation: 'Since 2015' indicates an action continuing up to now, so the present perfect continuous 'has been living' is used. Simple present, present continuous and simple past do not fit 'since'.

questions.question: Choose the correct relative pronoun: My brother, ___ lives in Pune, is a software engineer.
questions.explanation: The clause is non-defining (set off by commas) and refers to a person as subject of 'lives', so 'who' is correct. 'That' is not used in non-defining clauses; 'whom' is the object form; 'which' is for things.

questions.question: Change into a compound sentence: 'Though he is poor, he is honest.'
options: He is poor, so he is honest.
He is poor but he is honest.
Because he is poor he is honest.
He is poor, or he is honest.
questions.explanation: 'Though' (subordinate) is replaced by the coordinating conjunction 'but', making a compound sentence. 'So', 'because' and 'or' change the meaning.

questions.question: Change into indirect speech: He said, "I am writing a letter."
options: He said that I am writing a letter.
He said that he is writing a letter.
He said that he was writing a letter.
He said that he had written a letter.
questions.explanation: With a past reporting verb, the present continuous 'am writing' shifts to the past continuous 'was writing' and 'I' becomes 'he'. Other options keep the wrong tense or change it to past perfect.

questions.question: Under no circumstances ___ the examination hall before time.
questions.explanation: A negative adverbial at the beginning requires inversion of the auxiliary and the subject: 'may students leave'.

questions.question: If water is heated to 100 degrees Celsius, it ___.
questions.explanation: A general scientific truth uses the zero conditional: If + present simple, present simple. So 'boils'.

questions.question: Which sentence shows ellipsis (omission of words that are understood from the context)?
options: Ravi likes tea and Sita coffee.
Ravi likes tea and Sita likes coffee.
Ravi, who likes tea, is here.
questions.explanation: In 'Sita coffee' the verb 'likes' is omitted because it is understood from the first part. The other sentences have no omitted words.

questions.question: There is ___ hope of his recovery now, so the doctors have stopped trying.
questions.explanation: 'Little' means almost none (negative sense) with uncountable nouns like 'hope'. 'A little' has a positive sense; 'few' and 'a few' are used with countable nouns.

questions.question: Students ___ use mobile phones in the examination hall; it is strictly prohibited.
questions.explanation: 'Must not' expresses prohibition. 'Need not' means no necessity, while 'may' and 'can' suggest permission or possibility.

questions.question: Let us begin the class now, ___?
questions.explanation: The tag for 'Let us...' (a suggestion) is 'shall we?'. 'Will you' is used with imperatives; the others are wrong.

questions.question: She takes ___ her mother in looks.
questions.explanation: 'Take after' means to resemble a family member. 'Take up' means start a hobby, 'take over' means assume control, 'take for' means mistake for.

questions.question: The number of unemployed youths in the town ___ increasing.
questions.explanation: 'The number of' takes a singular verb because the subject is 'number'. ('A number of' would take a plural verb.)

questions.question: Rohit ___ for the bank examination for two years now.
questions.explanation: An action that began in the past and continues up to now with a duration ('for two years') takes the present perfect continuous: 'has been preparing'.

questions.question: In which sentence is the word 'light' used as an adjective?
questions.explanation: In 'This bag is very light' the word describes the noun 'bag', so it is an adjective. It is a noun in options 1 and 4 and a verb in option 3.

questions.question: Choose the correct lexical bundle: He went out to play ___ the fact that he had a fever.
questions.explanation: 'In spite of the fact that' is a standard fixed phrase. 'Despite of' and 'in despite of' are incorrect; 'in spite' alone is incomplete.

questions.question: What does the idiom 'to pull someone's leg' mean?
options: to tease or joke with someone
questions.explanation: 'To pull someone's leg' means to playfully fool or tease someone. It has nothing to do with the physical act.

questions.question: 'Peter Piper picked a peck of pickled peppers' is an example of ______.
questions.explanation: Repetition of the same initial consonant sound (p) in nearby words is alliteration.

questions.question: Which prefix means 'before'?
questions.explanation: 'Pre-' means before (e.g. prehistoric). 'Post-' means after, 'anti-' means against and 'semi-' means half.

questions.question: Choose the correct word: The nurse asked the patient to ___ his arm for the injection.
questions.explanation: 'Bare' means uncovered. 'Bear' means to carry or tolerate, 'beer' is a drink and 'bar' is a rod or a place to drink - they sound alike but do not fit.

questions.question: The Principal ___ a speech at the annual function.
questions.explanation: The standard collocation is 'deliver a speech' (or 'give a speech'). 'Say', 'tell' and 'talk' do not collocate with 'speech' this way.

questions.question: What is the noun form of the verb 'prove'?
questions.explanation: The noun form of 'prove' is 'proof'. 'Provement' does not exist, 'proven' is a participle and 'proving' is a gerund/participle.

questions.question: Fill in the blank: It goes without ___ that hard work brings success.
questions.explanation: 'It goes without saying' is a fixed expression meaning 'it is obvious'. The other verbs do not form this bundle.

questions.question: What is meant by 'a blessing in disguise'?
options: something good that seems bad at first
a disguise worn at a festival
questions.explanation: The idiom refers to something that looks unlucky at first but turns out to be beneficial. The other options misread it literally or give the opposite sense.

questions.question: The phrase 'deafening silence' is an example of -
questions.explanation: An oxymoron joins two contradictory words ('deafening' and 'silence'). There is no comparison, no repeated sound pattern and no sound-imitating word.

questions.question: Which of the following words is formed by compounding (joining two words)?
questions.explanation: 'Playground' = play + ground, two free words joined. 'Unhappy' uses a prefix, while 'quickly' and 'singer' use suffixes.

questions.question: In which sentence does 'bank' mean 'the sloping side of a river'?
options: He deposited his savings in the bank.
We sat on the grassy bank and watched the boats.
The blood bank needs more donors.
The bank is closed on Sundays.
questions.explanation: Only in the second sentence is 'bank' the land beside water. In the others it means a financial institution or a store of blood.

questions.question: She ___ a lie to her parents about her result.
questions.explanation: We 'tell a lie'. 'Say', 'speak' and 'talk' do not collocate with 'lie' in this way.

questions.question: What does 'to let the cat out of the bag' mean?
options: to reveal a secret by mistake
questions.explanation: It means to disclose a secret accidentally. The other options read the idiom literally or give unrelated meanings.

questions.question: Which statement best expresses the central idea of the passage?
options: Pulses are better crops than cereals.
Soil is a living system that needs care for good farming.
Plants can grow without soil organisms.
questions.explanation: The passage presents soil as a living partner in agriculture whose care decides future harvests. The other options contradict or are not supported by the text.

questions.question: According to the passage, bacteria living in the roots of pulses -
options: convert nitrogen from the air into a usable form
questions.explanation: The passage says these bacteria convert nitrogen from the air into a form that plants can absorb. The other options are not stated.

questions.question: Why have farmers traditionally rotated pulses with cereals?
options: Pulses help restore nitrogen in the soil
questions.explanation: Because pulse roots add usable nitrogen to the soil, rotation with cereals keeps the soil fertile. The other options are not supported.

questions.question: The word 'absorb' as used in the passage is closest in meaning to -
questions.explanation: Plants 'absorb' nitrogen means they take it in. 'Break down' refers to decomposition by microorganisms, not what plants do.

questions.question: 'Leaving the soil tired and lifeless' - the figure of speech used here is -
questions.explanation: Describing soil as 'tired' gives it a human quality, which is personification. There is no 'like/as' comparison, no contradictory statement and no exaggeration.

questions.question: Why was Arjun late to school?
options: He waited for a neighbour to look after his sick sister
He forgot to do his homework
questions.explanation: Arjun says his sister was feverish and he waited until the neighbour came to sit with her. The other reasons are not given.

questions.question: Why did Arjun not explain the reason earlier?
options: He was sure no one would listen to a boy.
He did not know the reason himself.
He was afraid it would be taken as an excuse.
He wanted to make Meera angry.
questions.explanation: He says he feared that she would think he was making excuses. The other options are not supported.

questions.question: How does Meera's attitude change during the conversation?
questions.explanation: She begins by scolding but softens and apologises after hearing the reason, so her tone moves from stern to understanding.

questions.question: 'Sorry does not mend a broken habit' means that -
options: a habit is always a physical object
apologies alone do not change repeated behaviour
Meera does not accept any apology
questions.explanation: Meera is saying that only saying sorry does not fix a repeated problem; action is needed. The other options misread the metaphor.

questions.question: Arrange these events in the order they occur in the extract: (P) Meera apologises; (Q) Arjun explains about his sister; (R) Meera asks where he was; (S) Meera offers help.
questions.explanation: Meera asks (R), Arjun explains (Q), Meera apologises (P) and finally offers help (S). The other orders do not match the conversation.

questions.question: The main argument of the editorial is that -
options: public libraries remain essential and deserve regular funding
questions.explanation: The writer argues that libraries are essential public services that should be funded regularly. The other options contradict the editorial.

questions.question: Which problem of small-town libraries is NOT mentioned in the passage?
options: Lack of computers in the library
questions.explanation: The passage mentions outdated volumes, leaking ceilings and one overworked clerk, but not computers.

questions.question: The writer's attitude towards the officials' argument is -
questions.explanation: Calling the argument 'shortsighted' shows disapproval, so the attitude is critical.

questions.question: The word 'redundant' in the passage means -
questions.explanation: Officials claim that libraries are not needed any more because of the internet; 'redundant' means unnecessary.

questions.question: 'Ornaments of the past' is an example of -
questions.explanation: Libraries are directly called 'ornaments' (things only for show) without 'like' or 'as', so it is a metaphor.

questions.question: Which language teaching method gives the greatest importance to pattern drills and repetition?
questions.explanation: The Audio-Lingual Method, based on behaviourism, relies on pattern drills, repetition and habit formation. Grammar-Translation focuses on rules and translation, the Direct Method on target-language use, and CLT on communication.
questions.questionHi: किस भाषा शिक्षण पद्धति में pattern drills और repetition को सबसे अधिक महत्व दिया जाता है?
questions.explanationHi: Audio-Lingual Method व्यवहारवाद (behaviourism) पर आधारित है और इसमें pattern drills, दोहराव तथा आदत-निर्माण पर ज़ोर होता है। Grammar-Translation नियमों व अनुवाद पर, Direct Method लक्ष्य-भाषा के प्रयोग पर और CLT संप्रेषण पर केंद्रित है।

questions.question: Which of the following is a suprasegmental feature of speech?
questions.questionHi: निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सी वाणी की अधिखंडीय (suprasegmental) विशेषता है?
questions.explanation: Intonation, stress and pitch extend over more than one sound, so they are suprasegmental. Vowels and consonants are segmental sounds, and a letter is a written symbol.
questions.explanationHi: सुर-लहर, बलाघात और तान एक से अधिक ध्वनियों पर फैलते हैं, इसलिए ये अधिखंडीय हैं। स्वर और व्यंजन खंडीय ध्वनियाँ हैं और अक्षर लिखित चिह्न है।

questions.question: The study of how context affects the meaning of language in use is called -
questions.questionHi: प्रयोग में भाषा के अर्थ पर संदर्भ (context) के प्रभाव का अध्ययन क्या कहलाता है?
questions.explanation: Pragmatics studies meaning in context, e.g., 'Can you open the window?' as a request. The other options deal with sounds, word forms and spelling.
questions.explanationHi: Pragmatics संदर्भ में अर्थ का अध्ययन है, जैसे 'Can you open the window?' एक अनुरोध है। अन्य विकल्प ध्वनि, शब्द-रूप और वर्तनी से जुड़े हैं।

questions.question: Which pair of language skills is receptive?
questions.questionHi: भाषा कौशलों का कौन-सा जोड़ा ग्रहणशील (receptive) है?
questions.explanation: Listening and reading are receptive skills, in which the learner takes in language. Speaking and writing are productive skills.
questions.explanationHi: सुनना और पढ़ना ग्रहणशील कौशल हैं, जिनमें विद्यार्थी भाषा ग्रहण करता है। बोलना और लिखना उत्पादक (productive) कौशल हैं।

questions.question: In the natural order of language learning, a child first -
questions.questionHi: भाषा सीखने के स्वाभाविक क्रम में बच्चा सबसे पहले क्या करता है?
optionsHi: सुनता है और फिर बोलता है
पढ़ता है और फिर लिखता है
questions.explanation: Children first listen to language around them and then begin to speak; reading and writing come later. Grammar rules are not memorised first.
questions.explanationHi: बच्चे पहले अपने आसपास की भाषा सुनते हैं, फिर बोलना शुरू करते हैं; पढ़ना-लिखना बाद में आता है। व्याकरण के नियम पहले नहीं रटे जाते।

questions.question: Which approach is most suitable for teaching grammar for communication?
questions.questionHi: संप्रेषण के लिए व्याकरण पढ़ाने की सबसे उपयुक्त पद्धति कौन-सी है?
options: Translating every sentence into the mother tongue
Drilling isolated rules for a long time
Teaching grammar in meaningful context through use
optionsHi: हर वाक्य का मातृभाषा में अनुवाद कराना
अलग-अलग नियमों का लंबा अभ्यास कराना
अर्थपूर्ण संदर्भ में प्रयोग के द्वारा व्याकरण पढ़ाना
questions.explanation: Grammar is best learnt in context, as a tool for expressing ideas. Isolated rule memorisation does not build communication skill.
questions.explanationHi: व्याकरण संदर्भ में, विचार व्यक्त करने के साधन के रूप में सबसे अच्छा सीखा जाता है। अलग-थलग नियम रटने से संप्रेषण कौशल नहीं बनता।

questions.question: A key feature of the Direct Method is -
questions.questionHi: प्रत्यक्ष विधि (Direct Method) की एक मुख्य विशेषता है -
options: use of the target language only, without translation
use of the mother tongue as the medium
optionsHi: अनुवाद के बिना केवल लक्ष्य भाषा का प्रयोग
questions.explanation: The Direct Method uses the target language alone in class and avoids translation. Translation and rule-first teaching belong to the Grammar-Translation method.
questions.explanationHi: Direct Method में कक्षा में केवल लक्ष्य भाषा का प्रयोग होता है और अनुवाद नहीं किया जाता। अनुवाद और नियम-पहले शिक्षण Grammar-Translation विधि की विशेषता हैं।

questions.question: The main aim of Communicative Language Teaching (CLT) is to develop -
questions.questionHi: संप्रेषणात्मक भाषा शिक्षण (CLT) का मुख्य उद्देश्य क्या विकसित करना है?
questions.explanation: CLT focuses on the ability to use language appropriately in real situations, i.e., communicative competence. It does not stress translation or terminology.
questions.explanationHi: CLT वास्तविक परिस्थितियों में भाषा का उचित प्रयोग करने की क्षमता, यानी communicative competence पर ध्यान देता है; अनुवाद या शब्दावली पर नहीं।

questions.question: In Task-Based Language Teaching (TBLT), learning mainly takes place through -
questions.questionHi: कार्य-आधारित भाषा शिक्षण (TBLT) में सीखना मुख्यतः किसके द्वारा होता है?
options: completing meaningful tasks using the language
optionsHi: भाषा का प्रयोग करते हुए अर्थपूर्ण कार्य पूरा करना
questions.explanation: TBLT organises learning around real tasks (e.g., planning a trip), where students use language to complete the task. Drills and memorisation are features of other methods.
questions.explanationHi: TBLT में सीखना वास्तविक कार्यों (जैसे यात्रा की योजना बनाना) के इर्द-गिर्द होता है, जहाँ विद्यार्थी कार्य पूरा करने के लिए भाषा का प्रयोग करते हैं। Drill और रटना अन्य विधियों की विशेषताएँ हैं।

questions.question: In a multilingual classroom, a teacher should regard students' home languages as -
questions.questionHi: बहुभाषी कक्षा में शिक्षक को विद्यार्थियों की घरेलू भाषाओं को क्या मानना चाहिए?
questions.explanation: Home languages are a valuable resource: they help learners connect new English words and ideas with what they already know. They should not be treated as a problem.
questions.explanationHi: घरेलू भाषाएँ एक मूल्यवान संसाधन हैं; इनसे विद्यार्थी नए अंग्रेज़ी शब्दों और विचारों को अपने पूर्व-ज्ञान से जोड़ पाते हैं। इन्हें समस्या नहीं मानना चाहिए।

questions.question: The term 'fossilization' in second-language learning refers to -
questions.questionHi: द्वितीय भाषा सीखने में 'फॉसिलाइज़ेशन' (fossilization) शब्द का अर्थ है -
options: permanent stagnation of incorrect forms in the learner's language
learning a language through fossils of old texts
optionsHi: सीखने वाले की भाषा में गलत रूपों का स्थायी रूप से जम जाना
व्याकरण का बहुत तेज़ी से सीखना
पुराने ग्रंथों के अवशेषों से भाषा सीखना
questions.explanation: Selinker used fossilization for incorrect features that become permanently fixed in a learner's interlanguage despite further exposure and instruction.
questions.explanationHi: सेलिंकर ने फॉसिलाइज़ेशन शब्द उन गलत विशेषताओं के लिए प्रयोग किया जो आगे अभ्यास के बावजूद सीखने वाले की अंतर्भाषा में स्थायी हो जाती हैं।

questions.question: Which of the following is a multimedia teaching-learning material?
questions.questionHi: निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सी बहुमाध्यम (multimedia) शिक्षण-अधिगम सामग्री है?
options: A video clip with audio and text
optionsHi: ऑडियो और पाठ वाली वीडियो क्लिप
questions.explanation: Multimedia combines more than one medium such as sound, text and moving images. A video clip with audio and text does this; the others are single-medium aids.
questions.explanationHi: Multimedia में ध्वनि, पाठ और चलचित्र जैसे एक से अधिक माध्यम होते हैं। ऑडियो-पाठ वाली वीडियो क्लिप ऐसी है; अन्य एकल-माध्यम साधन हैं।

questions.question: The first step in remedial teaching is -
questions.questionHi: उपचारात्मक शिक्षण (remedial teaching) का पहला चरण क्या है?
optionsHi: विद्यार्थी की कठिनाई का निदान करना
questions.explanation: Remedial work must begin with diagnosis so that teaching targets the actual problem. Extra homework or punishment does not address the cause.
questions.explanationHi: उपचारात्मक कार्य निदान से शुरू होता है ताकि शिक्षण वास्तविक समस्या पर केंद्रित हो। अतिरिक्त गृहकार्य या दंड से कारण का समाधान नहीं होता।

questions.question: Suggestopedia, a method of language teaching, was developed by -
questions.questionHi: भाषा-शिक्षण की विधि सजेस्टोपीडिया (Suggestopedia) किसने विकसित की?
questions.explanation: Suggestopedia was developed by the Bulgarian psychologist Georgi Lozanov. Asher developed TPR, Gattegno the Silent Way and Curran Community Language Learning.
questions.explanationHi: सजेस्टोपीडिया का विकास बल्गेरियाई मनोवैज्ञानिक जॉर्जी लोज़ानोव ने किया। आशेर ने TPR, गैटेग्नो ने साइलेंट वे और करन ने कम्युनिटी लैंग्वेज लर्निंग विकसित की।

questions.question: The concept of 'communicative competence' was introduced by -
questions.questionHi: 'संप्रेषणात्मक सक्षमता' (communicative competence) की अवधारणा किसने प्रस्तुत की?
questions.explanation: Dell Hymes introduced communicative competence, the ability to use language appropriately in social contexts, as a response to Chomsky's linguistic competence.
questions.explanationHi: डेल हाइम्स ने संप्रेषणात्मक सक्षमता की अवधारणा दी, अर्थात सामाजिक संदर्भों में भाषा का उचित प्रयोग करने की क्षमता, जो चॉम्स्की की भाषिक सक्षमता के प्रत्युत्तर में थी।

questions.question: A child obeys rules only to avoid punishment. According to Kohlberg, this is the -
questions.questionHi: एक बच्चा केवल दंड से बचने के लिए नियमों का पालन करता है। कोहलबर्ग के अनुसार यह कौन-सा स्तर है?
questions.explanation: Obeying to avoid punishment is the first stage of the pre-conventional level. Conventional level is based on social approval and law, and post-conventional on universal principles.
questions.explanationHi: दंड से बचने के लिए पालन करना पूर्व-परंपरागत स्तर का पहला चरण है। परंपरागत स्तर सामाजिक स्वीकृति और कानून पर, तथा उत्तर-परंपरागत स्तर सार्वभौमिक सिद्धांतों पर आधारित है।

questions.question: In his insight-learning experiments, Wolfgang Köhler used -
questions.questionHi: अपने अंतर्दृष्टि अधिगम (insight learning) प्रयोगों में वोल्फगैंग कोहलर ने किसका उपयोग किया?
questions.explanation: Köhler's famous experiments with the chimpanzee Sultan showed sudden insight in problem solving. Skinner used rats and pigeons, and Pavlov used dogs.
questions.explanationHi: कोहलर के चिम्पांज़ी सुल्तान पर किए प्रसिद्ध प्रयोगों में समस्या-समाधान में अचानक अंतर्दृष्टि दिखी। स्किनर ने चूहों व कबूतरों और पावलोव ने कुत्तों का प्रयोग किया।

questions.question: Who described adolescence as a period of 'storm and stress'?
questions.questionHi: किशोरावस्था को 'तूफान और तनाव' की अवस्था किसने कहा?
questions.explanation: G. Stanley Hall used the phrase 'storm and stress' for adolescence. The others are known for different theories.
questions.explanationHi: जी. स्टेनली हॉल ने किशोरावस्था के लिए 'तूफान और तनाव' शब्द का प्रयोग किया। अन्य विद्वान दूसरे सिद्धांतों के लिए जाने जाते हैं।

questions.question: Non-directive (client-centred) counselling was developed by -
questions.questionHi: अनिर्देशात्मक (client-centred) परामर्श का विकास किसने किया?
questions.explanation: Carl Rogers developed client-centred counselling. Williamson is associated with directive counselling; Skinner and Pavlov are learning theorists.
questions.explanationHi: कार्ल रोजर्स ने client-centred परामर्श विकसित किया। विलियमसन निर्देशात्मक परामर्श से जुड़े हैं; स्किनर और पावलोव अधिगम सिद्धांतकार हैं।

questions.question: Learning by watching and imitating the behaviour of a model is called -
questions.questionHi: किसी आदर्श (model) के व्यवहार को देखकर और अनुकरण करके सीखना क्या कहलाता है?
questions.explanation: Bandura's social learning theory calls this observational learning. Classical conditioning is Pavlov's, trial and error is Thorndike's and insight is Gestalt's.
questions.explanationHi: बंडूरा के सामाजिक अधिगम सिद्धांत में इसे अवलोकनात्मक अधिगम कहते हैं। शास्त्रीय अनुबंधन पावलोव का, प्रयत्न-त्रुटि थॉर्नडाइक का और अंतर्दृष्टि गेस्टाल्ट का सिद्धांत है।

questions.question: In Gardner's theory, a student who learns best through words, writing and reading shows strength in which intelligence?
questions.questionHi: गार्डनर के सिद्धांत में जो विद्यार्थी शब्दों, लेखन और पठन से सबसे अच्छा सीखता है, वह किस बुद्धि में मज़बूत है?
questions.explanation: Linguistic intelligence is the ability to use words effectively in speaking and writing. The other intelligences relate to numbers, movement and music.
questions.explanationHi: भाषायी बुद्धि बोलने और लिखने में शब्दों के प्रभावी प्रयोग की क्षमता है। अन्य बुद्धियाँ संख्या, गति और संगीत से संबंधित हैं।

questions.question: Which statement best describes 'measurement'?
questions.questionHi: 'मापन' (measurement) का सबसे उपयुक्त वर्णन कौन-सा है?
options: Assigning numbers to a characteristic according to rules
Judging the worth of a programme
optionsHi: नियमों के अनुसार किसी गुण को संख्याएँ देना
किसी कार्यक्रम के मूल्य का निर्णय करना
questions.explanation: Measurement is quantitative: it assigns numbers to a trait. Judging worth is evaluation; feedback and examinations are different concepts.
questions.explanationHi: मापन मात्रात्मक होता है; इसमें किसी गुण को संख्या दी जाती है। मूल्य का निर्णय करना मूल्यांकन है; फीडबैक और परीक्षा अलग अवधारणाएँ हैं।

questions.question: The main purpose of formative assessment is -
questions.questionHi: रचनात्मक आकलन (formative assessment) का मुख्य उद्देश्य है -
options: to promote students to the next class
to improve learning while teaching is going on
optionsHi: विद्यार्थियों को अगली कक्षा में प्रोन्नत करना
शिक्षण के दौरान ही अधिगम में सुधार करना
questions.explanation: Formative assessment is ongoing and gives feedback to improve learning. Promotion, ranking and certification are the purposes of summative assessment.
questions.explanationHi: रचनात्मक आकलन निरंतर चलता है और अधिगम सुधारने के लिए फीडबैक देता है। प्रोन्नति, क्रम और प्रमाणन योगात्मक आकलन के उद्देश्य हैं।

questions.question: A test is said to be 'valid' when it -
questions.questionHi: कोई परीक्षण 'वैध' (valid) तब कहलाता है जब वह -
options: gives the same result every time
measures what it is intended to measure
optionsHi: हर बार समान परिणाम देता है
वही मापता है जिसे मापने के लिए बना है
आसानी से जाँचा जा सकता है
questions.explanation: Validity means a test measures what it claims to measure. Giving consistent results is reliability; ease of scoring is objectivity/usability.
questions.explanationHi: वैधता का अर्थ है कि परीक्षण वही मापे जो मापने का दावा करता है। समान परिणाम देना विश्वसनीयता है; आसानी से जाँचना वस्तुनिष्ठता/उपयोगिता है।

questions.question: The degree to which test items represent the whole syllabus content being tested is called ____.
questions.explanation: Content validity checks how well the items sample the entire content area. Predictive validity relates scores to future performance, concurrent validity to a present criterion, and construct validity to a theoretical trait.
questions.questionHi: परीक्षण के प्रश्न जिस सीमा तक पूरे पाठ्यक्रम की विषय-वस्तु का प्रतिनिधित्व करते हैं, उसे ____ कहते हैं।
questions.explanationHi: Content validity यह जाँचती है कि प्रश्न पूरे विषय-क्षेत्र का कितना प्रतिनिधित्व करते हैं। Predictive validity भविष्य के प्रदर्शन से, concurrent वर्तमान मानदंड से और construct किसी सैद्धांतिक गुण से जुड़ी होती है।

questions.question: According to the Herbartian approach, the first step of a lesson plan is -
questions.questionHi: हरबर्टियन उपागम के अनुसार पाठ योजना का पहला चरण है -
questions.explanation: Herbart's steps are preparation, presentation, association, generalisation and application, so preparation comes first.
questions.explanationHi: हरबर्ट के चरण हैं: प्रस्तावना, प्रस्तुतीकरण, तुलना/संबंध, सामान्यीकरण और प्रयोग; इसलिए प्रस्तावना पहला चरण है।

questions.question: NCF 2005 strongly emphasises that learning should -
questions.questionHi: NCF 2005 किस बात पर विशेष बल देता है?
options: be linked to life outside school
optionsHi: सीखना विद्यालय के बाहर के जीवन से जुड़ा हो
सीखना केवल पाठ्यपुस्तक पर निर्भर हो
सीखने का उद्देश्य केवल परीक्षा के अंक हों
questions.explanation: NCF 2005 asks for connecting knowledge to life outside school and shifting away from rote learning. The other options are what it criticises.
questions.explanationHi: NCF 2005 ज्ञान को विद्यालय के बाहर के जीवन से जोड़ने और रटने से दूर जाने की बात करता है। अन्य विकल्प वही हैं जिनकी वह आलोचना करता है।

questions.question: In classroom dialogue, a teacher should mainly -
questions.questionHi: कक्षा संवाद में शिक्षक को मुख्यतः क्या करना चाहिए?
options: encourage open-ended questions and listen to students' ideas
optionsHi: केवल एक शब्द के उत्तर वाले प्रश्न पूछना
खुले प्रश्नों को प्रोत्साहित करना और विद्यार्थियों के विचार सुनना
questions.explanation: Dialogue needs two-way communication. Open-ended questions and careful listening build thinking; lecturing alone and avoiding questions do not.
questions.explanationHi: संवाद के लिए दो-तरफ़ा संप्रेषण ज़रूरी है। खुले प्रश्न और ध्यान से सुनना चिंतन बढ़ाते हैं; केवल व्याख्यान या प्रश्नों से बचना नहीं।

questions.question: Which practice best supports a teacher's professional development?
questions.questionHi: कौन-सी गतिविधि शिक्षक के व्यावसायिक विकास में सबसे अधिक सहायक है?
options: Reflecting regularly on one's own teaching
Using the same notes for years
optionsHi: अपने शिक्षण पर नियमित चिंतन करना
वर्षों तक वही नोट्स प्रयोग करना
questions.explanation: Reflective practice helps a teacher find strengths and gaps and improve. The other options prevent growth.
questions.explanationHi: चिंतनशील अभ्यास से शिक्षक अपनी शक्तियाँ और कमियाँ पहचानकर सुधार करता है। अन्य विकल्प विकास को रोकते हैं।

questions.question: A gender-sensitive teacher should -
questions.questionHi: लिंग-संवेदनशील शिक्षक को क्या करना चाहिए?
options: give leadership roles only to boys
assign only household-themed tasks to girls
expect girls to perform poorly in science
give equal opportunities to boys and girls in all activities
optionsHi: नेतृत्व की भूमिकाएँ केवल लड़कों को देना
लड़कियों को केवल घरेलू विषय वाले कार्य देना
लड़कियों से विज्ञान में कमज़ोर प्रदर्शन की अपेक्षा करना
सभी गतिविधियों में लड़कों और लड़कियों को समान अवसर देना
questions.explanation: Gender sensitivity means equal opportunity and avoiding stereotypes. The other options reinforce gender bias.
questions.explanationHi: लिंग-संवेदनशीलता का अर्थ है समान अवसर देना और रूढ़ियों से बचना। अन्य विकल्प लैंगिक पूर्वाग्रह को बढ़ाते हैं।

questions.question: 'चौराहा' शब्द में कौन-सा समास है?
questions.explanation: 'चौराहा' = चार राहों का समूह। इसमें पूर्व पद संख्यावाचक है और समूह का बोध होता है, इसलिए द्विगु समास है। अन्य विकल्प इस विग्रह से मेल नहीं खाते।

questions.question: 'महेश' का सही संधि-विच्छेद है -
questions.explanation: महा + ईश = महेश (गुण स्वर संधि: आ + ई = ए)। अन्य विकल्पों से 'महेश' नहीं बनता।

questions.question: शुद्ध वर्तनी वाला शब्द चुनिए -
questions.explanation: सही रूप 'श्रीमती' है। अन्य विकल्पों में मात्रा या वर्ण की गलती है।

questions.question: 'अतिक्रमण' शब्द में उपसर्ग है -
questions.explanation: अतिक्रमण = अति (उपसर्ग) + क्रमण। 'क्रम' मूल शब्द का अंश है, 'अत' और 'ण' उपसर्ग नहीं हैं।

questions.question: 'आग' का तत्सम रूप है -
questions.explanation: 'आग' शब्द संस्कृत के 'अग्नि' से बना है, इसलिए तत्सम रूप 'अग्नि' है। 'आग्नेय' विशेषण है और 'अगन' तथा 'अग्नी' अशुद्ध या भिन्न रूप हैं।

questions.question: In the sentence 'She sings sweetly', the word 'sweetly' is a/an -
questions.explanation: 'Sweetly' tells how she sings, so it modifies the verb and is an adverb. It does not name anything, describe a noun or show a relation.

questions.question: He was born ___ 5 March.
questions.explanation: 'On' is used with specific dates.

questions.question: Choose the word closest in meaning to 'CANDID'.
questions.explanation: 'Candid' means open and honest, i.e., frank. 'Secretive' and 'cunning' are not close and 'hesitant' means unsure.

questions.question: A speech delivered without any preparation is called -
questions.explanation: An unprepared speech is 'extempore'. A soliloquy is speaking to oneself, a monologue is a long speech by one person, and an oration is a formal public speech.

questions.question: Change into passive voice: 'The teacher punished the naughty boy.'
options: The naughty boy punished the teacher.
The naughty boy is punished by the teacher.
The naughty boy was punished by the teacher.
The naughty boy had been punished by the teacher.
questions.explanation: Simple past 'punished' becomes 'was punished' in the passive. The other options change the tense or the roles.

questions.question: If in a certain code TABLE is written as GZYOV, how will PEN be written in that code?
questions.questionHi: यदि किसी कूट में TABLE को GZYOV लिखा जाता है, तो उसी कूट में PEN को कैसे लिखा जाएगा?
questions.explanation: Each letter is replaced by its opposite in the alphabet (T-G, A-Z, B-Y). So P becomes K, E becomes V and N becomes M, giving KVM.
questions.explanationHi: प्रत्येक अक्षर को वर्णमाला में उसके विपरीत अक्षर से बदला गया है (T-G, A-Z, B-Y)। अतः P-K, E-V और N-M होकर KVM बनता है।

questions.question: A is B's sister. C is B's mother and D is C's father. How is A related to D?
questions.questionHi: A, B की बहन है। C, B की माता है और D, C के पिता हैं। A का D से क्या संबंध है?
questions.explanation: C is the mother of A as well, and D is C's father, so D is A's maternal grandfather. A is D's granddaughter.
questions.explanationHi: C, A की भी माता है और D, C के पिता हैं, इसलिए D, A के नाना हैं। अतः A, D की नातिन है।

questions.question: Facing East, Ravi turns 90 degrees anticlockwise and then 180 degrees. Which direction is he facing now?
questions.questionHi: पूर्व की ओर मुँह करके खड़ा रवि 90 अंश वामावर्त घूमता है और फिर 180 अंश घूमता है। अब उसका मुँह किस दिशा में है?
questions.explanation: East turned 90 degrees anticlockwise gives North. A further 180 degrees turn gives South.
questions.explanationHi: पूर्व से 90 अंश वामावर्त घूमने पर उत्तर होता है। फिर 180 अंश घूमने पर दक्षिण होता है।

questions.question: Ravi ranks 12th from the top in a class of 40 students. What is his rank from the bottom?
questions.questionHi: 40 विद्यार्थियों की कक्षा में रवि ऊपर से 12वें स्थान पर है। नीचे से उसका स्थान क्या है?
questions.explanation: Rank from bottom = 40 - 12 + 1 = 29.

questions.question: Statements: All pens are books. All books are tables. Conclusions: I. All pens are tables. II. All tables are books.
questions.questionHi: कथन: सभी पेन किताबें हैं। सभी किताबें मेज़ हैं। निष्कर्ष: I. सभी पेन मेज़ हैं। II. सभी मेज़ किताबें हैं।
optionsHi: केवल निष्कर्ष II अनुसरण करता है
I और II दोनों अनुसरण करते हैं
न I और न II अनुसरण करता है
केवल निष्कर्ष I अनुसरण करता है
questions.explanation: Pens are inside books and books are inside tables, so all pens are tables (I follows). The reverse, all tables are books, does not follow.
questions.explanationHi: पेन किताबों के अंदर हैं और किताबें मेज़ों के अंदर हैं, इसलिए सभी पेन मेज़ हैं (I सही)। इसका उल्टा, सभी मेज़ किताबें हैं, आवश्यक नहीं है।

questions.question: Which of the following is an impact printer?
questions.questionHi: निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सा इम्पैक्ट प्रिंटर है?
questions.explanation: A dot matrix printer prints by striking pins against a ribbon, so it is an impact printer. Laser, inkjet and thermal printers are non-impact.
questions.explanationHi: डॉट मैट्रिक्स प्रिंटर पिनों को रिबन पर मारकर छापता है, इसलिए यह इम्पैक्ट प्रिंटर है। लेज़र, इंकजेट और थर्मल प्रिंटर नॉन-इम्पैक्ट हैं।

questions.question: Linux is an example of -
questions.questionHi: Linux किसका उदाहरण है?
questions.explanation: Linux is an open-source operating system whose source code is freely available. It is not an application, language or browser.
questions.explanationHi: Linux एक ओपन-सोर्स ऑपरेटिंग सिस्टम है जिसका सोर्स कोड स्वतंत्र रूप से उपलब्ध है। यह एप्लीकेशन, भाषा या ब्राउज़र नहीं है।

questions.question: In MS Excel, every formula must begin with the sign -
questions.questionHi: MS Excel में हर सूत्र (formula) किस चिह्न से शुरू होना चाहिए?
questions.explanation: Excel treats an entry as a formula only if it begins with the equals sign (=).
questions.explanationHi: Excel किसी प्रविष्टि को तभी सूत्र मानता है जब वह बराबर (=) चिह्न से शुरू हो।

questions.question: The first page that appears when a website is opened is called the -
questions.questionHi: किसी वेबसाइट को खोलने पर सबसे पहले दिखने वाला पृष्ठ क्या कहलाता है?
questions.explanation: The opening page of a website, which links to its other pages, is the home page. A browser is software and a hyperlink is a clickable link.
questions.explanationHi: वेबसाइट का प्रारंभिक पृष्ठ, जो अन्य पृष्ठों से जोड़ता है, होम पेज कहलाता है। ब्राउज़र एक सॉफ़्टवेयर है और हाइपरलिंक क्लिक करने योग्य कड़ी है।

questions.question: A computer virus is -
questions.questionHi: कंप्यूटर वायरस क्या है?
options: a harmful program that can copy itself and damage files
a hardware fault in the monitor
optionsHi: एक हानिकारक प्रोग्राम जो स्वयं की प्रतिलिपि बना सकता है और फ़ाइलों को नुकसान पहुँचाता है
questions.explanation: A virus is malicious software that replicates and can corrupt files or programs. The other options are unrelated or the opposite.
questions.explanationHi: वायरस एक दुर्भावनापूर्ण सॉफ़्टवेयर है जो अपनी प्रतियाँ बनाता है और फ़ाइलों या प्रोग्रामों को नुकसान पहुँचा सकता है। अन्य विकल्प असंबंधित या विपरीत हैं।

questions.question: Under which Article can the President of India proclaim a National Emergency?
questions.questionHi: भारत के राष्ट्रपति किस अनुच्छेद के अंतर्गत राष्ट्रीय आपातकाल की घोषणा कर सकते हैं?
questions.explanation: Article 352 deals with National Emergency. Article 356 is President's Rule in a state and Article 360 is Financial Emergency.
questions.explanationHi: अनुच्छेद 352 राष्ट्रीय आपातकाल से संबंधित है। अनुच्छेद 356 राज्य में राष्ट्रपति शासन और अनुच्छेद 360 वित्तीय आपातकाल से संबंधित है।

questions.question: The 'Quit India Movement' was launched in -
questions.questionHi: 'भारत छोड़ो आंदोलन' किस वर्ष शुरू किया गया?
questions.explanation: The Quit India Movement was launched by Mahatma Gandhi in August 1942. 1930 was the Civil Disobedience Movement, 1920 the Non-Cooperation Movement and 1919 the Rowlatt Satyagraha year.
questions.explanationHi: भारत छोड़ो आंदोलन महात्मा गांधी ने अगस्त 1942 में शुरू किया। 1930 सविनय अवज्ञा, 1920 असहयोग और 1919 रौलट सत्याग्रह का वर्ष है।

questions.question: The Reserve Bank of India was established in -
questions.questionHi: भारतीय रिज़र्व बैंक की स्थापना किस वर्ष हुई?
questions.explanation: The RBI began operations on 1 April 1935. It was nationalised in 1949.
questions.explanationHi: RBI ने 1 अप्रैल 1935 को कार्य शुरू किया। इसका राष्ट्रीयकरण 1949 में हुआ।

questions.question: The SI unit of force is ______.
questions.questionHi: बल (force) का SI मात्रक ______ है।
questions.explanation: Force is measured in newtons (N). Joule is energy, watt is power and pascal is pressure.
questions.explanationHi: बल का मात्रक न्यूटन (N) है। जूल ऊर्जा का, वाट शक्ति का और पास्कल दाब का मात्रक है।

questions.question: Kanger Valley National Park is located in which district of Chhattisgarh?
questions.questionHi: कांगेर घाटी राष्ट्रीय उद्यान छत्तीसगढ़ के किस जिले में स्थित है?
questions.explanation: Kanger Valley National Park lies in the Bastar region near Jagdalpur, in Bastar district.
questions.explanationHi: कांगेर घाटी राष्ट्रीय उद्यान बस्तर क्षेत्र में जगदलपुर के पास बस्तर जिले में स्थित है।
